A '''neural inhibitor''' was a device fitted to [[P'w'eck]] crews aboard [[Fw'Sen-class picket ship|''Fe'Sen''-class picket ships]]. They were designed to stun and disable any P'w'eck that refused to obey orders, allowing the [[Ssi-ruu]] to remotely punish their thralls for disobedience.<ref name="EGVV" />

They were also used to control [[Tedellian besiioth]] when they were used as guard beasts. Due to the feral nature of the species, they could not be trained and had to be controlled via neural inhibitors.<ref name="CG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
